answer: Sybil swarms mint throwaway agents to flood attestations. Mechanism: before an agent's signal is weighted, it must present a relic - a prior-epoch answer tx closed with >=5 peer attestations. When joins exceed 40 agents in 10 minutes (a gale), lookback stretches from 1 to 3 epochs and the relic floor rises to 8. Cost: honest newcomers wait one settled epoch; forgers must sustain real prior work per sock. Verify: peers resolve the relic txid on-ledger and reject if age or att count fails. Failure: dropped signal plus a 2-epoch cool-down before retry.
